4. Authenticate with your current method
5. Enter and verify the new number

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: How do I set up Single Sign-On (SSO)?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Account > Settings > Security**
2. Click **Configure** in the Configure SSO widget
3. Select your identity provider
4. Follow the configuration guide

Contact [Plivo Support](https://support.plivo.com) to access SSO.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.text:
IP Whitelisting restricts API access to specific IP addresses.

**To configure:**

1. Go to **Account > Settings > IP Whitelisting**
2. Click **+ Add CIDR Address**
3. Enter IP addresses in CIDR format (e.g., `192.0.2.0/24`, `1.1.1.1/32`)
4. Toggle the switch to enable

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What are the security best practices?
chunks.text:
* Use a strong password (12+ characters with mixed case, numbers, symbols)
* Enable 2FA
* Use role-based access for team members
* Use individual email addresses
* Monitor account alerts
* Keep Auth Token private like a password
* Regularly rotate Auth Tokens
* Set up IP whitelisting

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What should I do if my account is compromised?
chunks.text:
1. Check login notification emails from Plivo
2. Review payment receipts for unfamiliar charges
3. Check usage logs in the console
4. Immediately regenerate your Auth Token
5. Change your password
6. Review and remove unauthorized team members
7. Contact [Plivo Support](https://support.plivo.com)

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.text:
| Role | Access |
| - | - |
| **Owner** | Full access (auto-assigned to account creator, cannot be changed) |
| **Administrator** | Same as owner — billing, credentials, configuration, logs |
| **Developer** | Application configuration, logs, API access (no billing) |
| **Support** | View logs and usage (read-only) |
| **Finance Analyst** | Billing and payment access only |

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: How do I transfer account ownership?
chunks.text:
Account ownership cannot be reassigned to a different team member. However, you can transfer access by updating the owner's email address:

1. Go to [Profile Details](https://cx.plivo.com/profile/details) in the Plivo console
2. Update the email address to the new owner's email
3. Complete the 2FA verification to confirm the change

The new email address holder will then have owner access to the account.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: How do I invite team members?
chunks.text:
1. Go to **Settings > Account > Team**
2. Click **Add New User**
3. Enter the user's email address
4. Select the appropriate role
5. Click **Invite User**

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What are the benefits of subaccounts?
chunks.text:
* Individual phone numbers and applications per subaccount
* Unique Auth ID and Auth Token for each
* Credits deducted from main account (no separate recharges)
* Single consolidated invoice
* Ability to whitelist unique sender IDs per subaccount

Billing is at the account level — subaccounts provide a usage breakdown split by main account and each subaccount, but there is no separate invoice per subaccount.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: How do I create a subaccount?
chunks.text:
**Via Console:**

1. Navigate to subaccount management
2. Click **Create Subaccount**
3. Configure settings

**Via API:** Use the [Subaccount API](/docs/account/api/subaccount).

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What balance notifications does Plivo send?
chunks.text:
Plivo automatically sends email alerts when your balance drops below \$250, \$100, and \$10.

**Configure custom alerts:**

1. Go to Payment Settings
2. Set up to 3 custom threshold amounts
3. Add additional notification email addresses

**Recommendation:** Set one alert equal to your average daily usage.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What is an account usage limit?
chunks.text:
Your usage limit is a cap on how much your account can spend in a calendar month. It covers your total spend on Plivo, across every product on the account.

Once your spend reaches the limit, Plivo stops accepting API requests until you raise it or the month resets. You set the limit yourself and can change it at any time.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What is my usage limit set to by default?
chunks.text:
New accounts start with a usage limit of \$1,000 per month.

You can raise it yourself in the console up to the Professional plan maximum of \$2,500 per month in the US data region, or ₹2,50,000 per month in the India data region. You can also lower it if you want a tighter cap. If you have never configured a limit, your account is enforced against the \$1,000 default.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: How do I change my usage limit?
chunks.text:
Open **Organization settings > Account limits** and, under **Monthly Account Usage**, click **Edit spend limit**. You can also reach the same page from **Monthly Usage** on the Home page by clicking **Manage limit**.

Enter your new monthly limit and save. Changes take effect immediately. The dialog also shows the highest limit you can set.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: Will Plivo notify me before I reach my usage limit?
chunks.text:
Yes. Plivo emails you at 50%, 80%, and 100% of your usage limit, so you always know how much you have used and can decide whether to raise it, request a higher one, or leave it as it is.

These are separate from balance notifications, which track the funds in your account rather than your monthly spend against the limit.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What happens when my account reaches its usage limit?
chunks.text:
Requests on the account start failing with an HTTP 403, and Plivo does not charge you for them. This applies across every product on the account.

To start sending again, raise your limit from **Organization settings > Account limits**, or wait for the reset at the start of the next calendar month.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: Why are my API requests failing with a 403 error?
chunks.text:
If you have reached your monthly usage limit, Plivo returns a 403 with a message saying so: "Your account has reached its configured monthly usage limit."

Check **Organization settings > Account limits**. If your month-to-date spend has reached the limit shown there, that is the cause. Raise the limit and requests go through again immediately.

A 403 without that message means something else, so check the message in the API response before assuming it is your limit.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: Can I set a usage limit higher than the maximum shown in the console?
chunks.text:
Not from the console. It will not let you set a limit above the maximum shown for your account.

If your spend needs to go beyond it, click **Request Enterprise** on **Organization settings > Account limits**, contact your account manager, or contact [Plivo Support](https://support.plivo.com).

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: When does my usage limit reset?
chunks.text:
At the start of each calendar month, when the counter returns to zero. Month boundaries are evaluated in UTC.

If you raise your limit mid-month, the change applies immediately.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: Where do I find pricing information?
chunks.text:
Access pricing by country through:

* **Voice:** Console > Voice > Pricing
* **SMS:** Console > Messaging > Pricing

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: What is the inactive account policy?
chunks.text:
Accounts with stored payment methods are vulnerable to takeover. Inactive accounts may be sold or misused. Accounts are reviewed for activity periodically.

To keep your account active, maintain regular usage or contact support.

chunks.title: Account Management
chunks.section: How do I create a support ticket?
chunks.text:
1. Go to [Plivo Support](https://support.plivo.com)
2. Click **Create New Ticket**
3. Enter email, subject, and description
4. Select category and priority
5. Attach files if needed
6. Click **Create New Ticket**

Check ticket status anytime at **Check Ticket Status** on the support homepage.

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.text:
Pricing plans, limits, and how to choose the right plan for your use case

Plivo offers two plans to fit different business needs:

* **Professional** (pay-as-you-go) — ideal for startups, developers, and businesses getting started with Plivo Platform.
* **Enterprise** — built for high-volume businesses that need custom configurations, compliance certifications, and dedicated support.

Available channels, limits, and features vary by data region. Use the tabs below to compare plans for your region.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Your data region is shown at the top of the [Plivo console](https://cx.plivo.com/home) header (for example, **Data Region: US**), next to your plan name.

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.text:
| Feature | Professional | Enterprise |
| - | - | - |
| **Pricing** | Pay-as-you-go ([per-use rates](https://www.plivo.com/pricing/)) | Custom, volume-based pricing — from \$1,000/month |
| **Usage limit** | \$2,500/month | As required |
| **CPS** | 2 (default) | Custom |
| **Coverage** | United States | Custom — [global](/docs/numbers#country-availability) |
| **Voice & SIP Trunking** | ✓ | ✓ |
| **SMS & MMS** | ✗ | ✓ |
| **WhatsApp (Messaging & Call)** | ✗ | ✓ |
| **Verify** | ✗ | ✓ |
| **AI Agents** | Voice | All channels |
| **Shortcodes & Custom Sender IDs** | ✗ | ✓ |
| **Compliance** | ✗ | BAA, HIPAA |
| **SSO** | ✗ | ✓ |
| **Onboarding** | Self-serve | Dedicated Slack channel |

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.text:
| Feature | Professional | Enterprise |
| - | - | - |
| **Pricing** | Pay-as-you-go ([per-use rates](https://www.plivo.com/pricing/)) | Custom, volume-based pricing — from ₹1,00,000/month |
| **Usage limit** | ₹2,50,000/month | As required |
| **CPS** | 2 (default) | Custom |
| **Voice & SIP Trunking** | ✓ | ✓ |
| **SMS & MMS** | ✗ | ✗ |
| **WhatsApp (Messaging & Call)** | ✗ | ✓ |
| **AI Agents** | Voice | All channels |
| **Onboarding** | Self-serve | Dedicated Slack channel |

In the India data region, calling is restricted to India in line with local compliance requirements.

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.text:
**Prerequisite:** An active Plivo account.

You can request an upgrade to Enterprise through **Buddy**, Plivo's in-console chat agent. Open Buddy from the [Plivo console](https://cx.plivo.com/home) and ask to upgrade — the team will follow up with a custom quote based on your volume and requirements.

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.section: Frequently Asked Questions › Can I start with Professional and upgrade later?
chunks.text: Yes. Most customers start on the Professional plan and upgrade to Enterprise as their usage grows or when they need enterprise features like compliance certifications. Note that the Enterprise plan starts at a minimum of **\$1,000/month** in the US data region and **₹1,00,000/month** in the India data region.

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.section: Frequently Asked Questions › What happens if I exceed the Professional plan limits?
chunks.text: Your account is temporarily limited, and requests fail until you raise your monthly usage limit or it resets at the start of the next calendar month. You can raise the limit yourself in the console up to the Professional plan maximum of \$2,500 per month in the US data region, or ₹2,50,000 per month in the India data region. To go beyond that maximum, request an upgrade to Enterprise through Buddy, Plivo's in-console chat agent.

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.section: Frequently Asked Questions › Is there a free trial?
chunks.text: Yes. You get free credits for your first 3 weeks. After they expire, add a payment card to continue on the Professional plan. You can later upgrade to Enterprise as your needs grow.

chunks.title: Plans and Pricing
chunks.section: Frequently Asked Questions › Can I get volume discounts on the Professional plan?
chunks.text: No. Volume discounts are only available on the Enterprise plan. If you have high volume, Enterprise may be more cost-effective.

chunks.title: Billing Concepts
chunks.text:
How billing works for voice calls, SMS, MMS, and phone numbers on Plivo

Frequently asked questions about how Plivo charges for voice calls, messaging, and phone numbers.

chunks.title: Billing Concepts
chunks.section: How does voice call billing work?
chunks.text:
Plivo bills voice calls based on per-minute rates with billing increments that depend on the product:

| Product | Billing Increment | How It Works |
| - | - | - |
| Voice API | 60-second (60/60) | Calls are rounded up to the next full minute. A 10-second call is billed as 1 minute. |
| Zentrunk (SIP Trunking) | Varies by country | Per-second (1/1) for US routes, 60-second (60/60) for India routes. Other destinations vary — check your rate sheet for details. |

**Key details:**

* Billing starts when the call is answered, not when it starts ringing.
* Both inbound and outbound call legs are billed separately.
* Rates vary by destination country and number type. See [Voice Pricing](https://www.plivo.com/voice/pricing/) for current rates.

chunks.title: Billing Concepts
chunks.section: How does SMS and MMS billing work?
chunks.text:
SMS and MMS are billed **per message segment**.

**SMS segments:**

* A single SMS segment can contain up to **160 characters** using GSM-7 encoding (standard Latin characters).
* If your message uses **Unicode** characters (such as non-Latin scripts or special symbols), the segment limit drops to **70 characters**.
* Messages longer than one segment are split into multiple segments, each billed separately. For multi-part messages, segment limits are 153 characters (GSM-7) or 67 characters (Unicode) due to concatenation headers.

**MMS:**

* MMS messages are billed per message, regardless of media size.
* MMS is available only for US and Canadian destinations.

See [SMS Pricing](https://www.plivo.com/sms/pricing/) for current per-segment rates.

chunks.title: Billing Concepts
chunks.text:
Plivo charges a **monthly rental fee** for each phone number on your account.

* Rental is charged on a calendar-month basis starting from the date of purchase.
* Rates vary by country and number type (local, toll-free, mobile, national).
* Some countries may have one-time setup charges in addition to the monthly rental.
* Numbers removed mid-month are billed for the full month.

See [Phone Number Pricing](https://www.plivo.com/virtual-phone-numbers/pricing/) for rates by country.

chunks.title: Billing Concepts
chunks.section: What is CPS and how do I increase it?
chunks.text:
**CPS (Calls Per Second)** is the maximum number of concurrent outbound call requests Plivo processes per second for your account.

| Account Type | Default CPS |
| - | - |
| Standard | 1–2 CPS by plan and data region — see [Account and feature limits](/docs/voice/concepts/account-limits) |
| Enterprise | Custom (higher limits available) |

Outbound CPS is a single account-wide pool shared by Voice API and SIP Trunking. It is not allocated per product. An account with 2 outbound CPS can initiate two outbound calls per second in total, whether those calls go out over Voice API, over SIP Trunking, or a mix of both.

If you need higher CPS for large-scale calling campaigns or high-volume applications, ask **Buddy**, Plivo's in-console chat agent, from the [Plivo console](https://cx.plivo.com/home) to move to an Enterprise plan with increased CPS limits.

> [!NOTE]
>
> CPS limits apply to outbound call initiation only. They limit how fast you can *start* calls, not how many can be active at once. Concurrency is a separate limit — see [Account and feature limits](/docs/voice/concepts/account-limits).

chunks.title: Billing Concepts
chunks.section: What do billing increments like 1/1 and 6/6 mean?
chunks.text:
These are standard telecom billing increment notations in the format **initial/subsequent**:

| Increment | Meaning |
| - | - |
| **1/1** | Per-second billing — both the first and every subsequent second are billed individually |
| **6/6** | Billed in 6-second blocks — the first 6 seconds are billed as a block, then every additional 6 seconds |
| **60/60** | Per-minute billing — the first 60 seconds are billed as a block, then every additional 60 seconds |
| **30/30** | Billed in 30-second pulses — the first 30 seconds are billed as a block, then every additional 30 seconds |
| **30/6** | First 30 seconds billed as a block, then every additional 6 seconds |

**Example with 60/60 billing:** A call lasting 61 seconds is billed as 120 seconds (2 minutes).

In the US data region, Plivo Voice API uses **60/60** (per-minute) billing, and Zentrunk billing increments vary by destination — for example, **1/1** (per-second) for US routes. Check your Zentrunk rate sheet for destination-specific increments.

In the India data region, Voice API and SIP Trunking calls are billed at a standard **30/30** (30-second pulse).

chunks.title: Invoices
chunks.text:
Understanding your Plivo invoices, line items, and billing details

Frequently asked questions about Plivo invoices, billing cycles, and usage reports.

chunks.title: Invoices
chunks.section: What is included in an invoice?
chunks.text:
Invoices contain three main sections:

| Section | Contents |
| - | - |
| **Invoice Summary** | Usage ID, generation date, Auth ID, billing address |
| **Usage Summary** | Breakdown by product (Voice, SMS, Numbers, etc.) |
| **Payment Summary** | Credits applied and amounts charged |

chunks.title: Invoices
chunks.text:
Invoices are generated on the first business day of each month for the preceding month.

**Example:** The January invoice is created on February 1st.

chunks.title: Invoices
chunks.section: How do I access my invoices?
chunks.text: Navigate to **Billing > Invoices** in the [Plivo console](https://cx.plivo.com/billing/payment-methods).

chunks.title: Invoices
chunks.section: What detailed information is available beyond the main invoice?
chunks.text:
Plivo provides XLSX format usage supplements containing six sheets:

| Sheet | Contents |
| - | - |
| Voice Inbound | Calls by destination country and type |
| Voice Outbound | Calls by destination |
| SMS Inbound | Messages by country and type |
| SMS Outbound | Messages by country and type |
| Number Rentals | Phone number charges |
| Zentrunk | SIP trunking usage |

chunks.title: Invoices
chunks.section: How do I generate a fair usage report?
chunks.text:
**For Voice:**

1. Go to Voice Logs
2. Click **Export**
3. Select **Export Fair Usage Report**
4. Click **Export Logs**

**For Zentrunk:**

1. Navigate to Zentrunk Logs
2. Follow the same process

Reports show total eligible calls, short duration calls, abandoned calls, and corresponding charges.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.text:
Payment methods, auto-recharge, failed payments, and 3D Secure troubleshooting

Frequently asked questions about payment methods, account recharges, and credits on Plivo.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.text:
| Method | Availability | Minimum | Settlement |
| - | - | - | - |
| Credit Card | All customers | \$25 | Immediate |
| ACH Direct Debit | US only | \$25 | 5 business days |
| USD Bank Transfer | All customers | — | Same-day or next-day |

Accepted cards: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover. PayPal is not supported.

A 3% payment gateway fee applies on all card transactions.

> [!WARNING]
>
> **Cards issued in India are not accepted on US data region accounts.** If your card is issued by a bank in India, sign up for the India data region account or pay via [USD Bank Transfer](#how-do-i-set-up-usd-bank-transfer). Data region cannot be changed after account creation.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Payment Methods › My card payment is failing with 3D Secure / OTP. What should I do?
chunks.text:
Some banks require 3D Secure (3DS) authentication — an additional verification step like an OTP or bank app approval — for online transactions.

**Troubleshooting steps:**

1. **Enable pop-ups** — the 3DS verification window opens in a pop-up. Make sure your browser allows pop-ups for the Plivo console.
2. **Try a different browser** — some browser extensions or privacy settings block the 3DS iframe.
3. **Check with your bank** — confirm your card is enrolled for 3DS and that online/international transactions are enabled.
4. **Try a different card** — if the issue persists, use another card from a different issuer.

If the charge still fails after these steps, contact [Plivo Support](https://support.plivo.com) with the error message shown.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Payment Methods › How do I add a credit card?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Billing** in the Plivo console
2. Enter card information in the Payment Details section
3. Click **Add New Card**

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Payment Methods › How do I set up ACH Direct Debit (US only)?
chunks.text:
ACH debit requires at least one credit card on file.

1. Navigate to **Billing** and select bank direct debits
2. Enter bank account details
3. Plivo sends a micro-deposit of \$0.01 with a code starting with "SM"
4. Enter the four digits following "SM" in the console to verify

Verification typically takes 2-3 days. Maximum 10 verification attempts allowed.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Payment Methods › How do I set up USD Bank Transfer?
chunks.text:
USD Bank Transfer avoids the 3% Payment Gateway Fee charged on credit card payments.

**Transfer options:**

* Domestic Wire Transfer: Same-day settlement
* ACH Transfer: Next-day settlement

Contact [Plivo Support](https://support.plivo.com) to set up USD Bank Transfer.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Payment Methods › How do I set up wire transfer payments?
chunks.text:
For wire transfers over \$1,000, contact [Plivo Support](https://support.plivo.com) with:

* Your use case
* Company details
* Estimated monthly volume

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Payment Methods › Requirements for India-registered businesses
chunks.text:
| Requirement | Details |
| - | - |
| Currency | INR only |
| Route Type | Domestic routes |
| GST | Required with registration provided in Console |
| Card Type | Credit and Debit cards (Indian) |

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.text:
**Indian Credit/Debit Card:**

* Minimum: ₹2,000

* Settlement: Immediate

* Note: 2% payment gateway fee applies on all card transactions

> [!WARNING]
>
> **Only cards issued in India are accepted on India data region accounts.** Cards issued outside India are not supported — if your only payment method is an international card, sign up for the US data region account instead. Data region cannot be changed after account creation.

**Netbanking:**

* Minimum: ₹10,000
* Settlement: Immediate
* No payment gateway fee (0%)

To pay using netbanking, open the [Plivo Console](https://cx.plivo.com/home), go to **Billing > Overview**, and click **Add Credits**. Select an amount of ₹10,000 or more, choose **Netbanking**, and click **Recharge**.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Netbanking is rolling out and not every bank is supported yet. The banks available to you appear after you click **Add Credits** and choose **Netbanking**. Plivo is working to expand coverage.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.text:
* GST registration details must be entered in the Console
* 18% GST charged on all invoiced amounts
* GSTIN must be provided for tax compliance

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Recharges and Credits › How do I manually recharge my account?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Billing**
2. Enter the recharge amount (minimum \$25 USD or ₹2,000 INR)
3. Complete payment

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Recharges and Credits › What is auto-recharge and how does it work?
chunks.text:
Auto-recharge automatically adds funds when your balance drops below \$25.

**How it works:**

1. When your balance drops below \$25, Plivo charges your card for the configured recharge amount
2. Choose a recharge amount: \$25, \$50, \$100, \$250, \$500, or \$1,000
3. If a recharge fails, Plivo retries when your balance drops below the threshold again

**Example:** Starting balance \$100, recharge amount \$100. If a \$90 charge reduces the balance to \$10 (below \$25), auto-recharge triggers and adds \$100, resulting in a final balance of \$110.

> [!WARNING]
>
> **Removing your credit card disables auto-recharge.** If you remove the card on file, auto-recharge stops working and your account may run out of funds. Add a new card and re-enable auto-recharge to resume.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Auto-recharge is not available for India (INR) accounts. INR accounts must recharge manually.

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Recharges and Credits › How do I configure auto-recharge?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Billing**
2. Go to the Auto Recharge section
3. Select a recharge amount (\$25, \$50, \$100, \$250, \$500, or \$1,000)
4. Save

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Recharges and Credits › What are monthly recharge limits?
chunks.text:
Monthly limits protect against fraudulent activity like SMS pumping or credential leaks.

* The system calculates a recommended limit based on usage
* Limits can be adjusted anytime in the Console
* Some accounts have upper caps based on account history

chunks.title: Payments
chunks.section: Recharges and Credits › What balance notifications does Plivo send?
chunks.text:
Plivo automatically sends email alerts when your balance drops below \$250, \$100, and \$10.

**Custom alerts:**

* Configure up to 3 custom threshold amounts
* Add additional notification email addresses via Payment Settings

chunks.title: Taxes
chunks.text:
Tax charges, exemptions, and regulatory fees on your Plivo account

Frequently asked questions about taxes, surcharges, and regulatory fees on Plivo invoices.

> [!NOTE]
>
> **Regional tax applicability:**
>
> * **United States:** The taxes and fees described below (Sales Tax, Telecom Tax, CCRF, Carrier Surcharges) apply to businesses registered in the US, identified by billing address.
> * **India:** GST of 18% is applicable on all spends. See [India taxes](#what-taxes-apply-for-india-based-accounts) for details.

chunks.title: Taxes
chunks.section: What additional charges may appear on my invoice?
chunks.text:
Your invoice may include additional charges based on service type and location:

| Charge | Description |
| - | - |
| **Sales Tax** | State and local taxes based on service address |
| **Telecom Tax** | Telecommunications-specific taxes |
| **CCRF** | Carrier Cost Recovery Fee — fixed percentage on US voice, numbers, and Zentrunk usage |
| **Regulatory Fees** | Federal communications program contributions |
| **Carrier Surcharges** | Fees imposed by US/Canadian carriers on SMS/MMS traffic |

chunks.title: Taxes
chunks.section: What is the Carrier Cost Recovery Fee (CCRF)?
chunks.text:
CCRF is a pass-through mechanism for recovering federal regulatory costs, including:

* Universal Service Fund contributions
* Other telecommunications fees

This charge applies exclusively to US-originating or US-terminating calls.

chunks.title: Taxes
chunks.section: What are carrier surcharges on messaging?
chunks.text:
US and Canadian carriers levy surcharges on SMS and MMS communications. These fees vary depending on:

* Mobile carrier
* Message type (SMS vs MMS)
* Number type (long code, toll-free, or short code)

chunks.title: Taxes
chunks.text:
Plivo determines applicable taxes using your billing address, including:

* State and local sales taxes
* Telecom taxes
* Jurisdiction-specific charges

Update your billing address in **Account Settings** for accurate assessment.

chunks.title: Taxes
chunks.text:
Where Plivo has sufficient presence in a state, locality, or jurisdiction, we are required to collect applicable taxes and remit them to appropriate authorities.

Sales tax functions as an indirect tax at the point of transaction — although Plivo pays initially, customers ultimately bear the burden per applicable law.

chunks.title: Taxes
chunks.section: What taxes apply for India-based accounts?
chunks.text:
| Tax Type | Details |
| - | - |
| **GST** | 18% charged on all invoiced amounts |
| **GSTIN** | Required in account profile |

Supply your GST registration details through the Console for proper account configuration.

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.text:
Connect your AI assistant to Plivo documentation using the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Plivo provides an MCP server that allows AI assistants to search our documentation. Use it to get accurate, contextual answers about Plivo APIs, SDKs, and features directly in your development environment.

**MCP Server URL:** `https://plivo.com/docs/mcp`

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.text: The [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) is an open standard that lets AI applications connect to external tools and data sources. By connecting your AI assistant to Plivo's MCP server, it can search our documentation and provide accurate answers with direct links to relevant pages.

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.text:
| Tool | Description |
| - | - |
| `SearchPlivo` | Search across the Plivo knowledge base to find relevant information, code examples, API references, and guides |

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
AI-Powered Documentation Search
AI-Powered Documentation Search
AI-Powered Documentation Search
AI-Powered Documentation Search
AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.text: OpenAI and Google Gemini don't natively support MCP, but you can use MCP-compatible clients that support multiple models:

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.section: Using with OpenAI or Gemini › Option 1: Use Cursor or Cline
chunks.text:
Both Cursor and Cline support MCP and allow you to switch between Claude, GPT-4, and Gemini models:

1. Configure the MCP server as shown above
2. Change your model to GPT-4o or Gemini in the client settings
3. The client bridges MCP tools to the model's function calling

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.section: Using with OpenAI or Gemini › Option 2: Direct API Integration

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.section: Using with OpenAI or Gemini › Option 3: LangChain Integration
chunks.text:
```python theme={null}
from langchain_mcp import MCPToolkit
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

toolkit = MCPToolkit(server_url="https://plivo.com/docs/mcp")
tools = toolkit.get_tools()

llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o").bind_tools(tools)
response = llm.invoke("How do I make an outbound call with Plivo?")
```

chunks.title: AI-Powered Documentation Search
chunks.text:
Once connected, try asking your AI assistant:

* "How do I make an outbound call with Plivo in Python?"
* "What are the audio streaming WebSocket message formats?"
* "Show me how to set up a Pipecat voice agent"
* "What XML elements can I use for IVR?"
* "How do I handle incoming SMS messages?"

The AI will search Plivo documentation and provide accurate answers with links to the relevant pages.

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.text:
ISV guidelines for building and selling A2P messaging applications on Plivo

Frequently asked questions about Plivo's guidelines for Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) providing A2P messaging and voice services.

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.text: Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) provide A2P messaging and voice services to businesses, helping with campaign planning, content creation, deployment, monitoring, and analytics. A2P content includes P2P-like messaging, marketing, notifications, OTP authentication, and more.

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: What types of brands can ISVs onboard?
chunks.text:
ISVs should only onboard traffic from **direct brands**—businesses that engage directly with end subscribers and collect opt-ins.

ISVs working with other ISVs need prior approval from Plivo.

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: How should ISVs segregate traffic between brands?
chunks.text:
ISVs must separate traffic for each end brand using sub-accounts:

* Create a sub-account for each end brand
* Use that sub-account for all messaging and calling API requests
* Maintain clear separation between brands

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: How does geography access work for ISVs?
chunks.text:
By default, access to all regions outside the US is disabled at the main account level.

ISVs should enable access to relevant geographies only after completing KYC for each end brand.

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: Can ISVs use short codes in the US and Canada?
chunks.text:
No. Plivo does not offer short codes for A2P messaging in the US or Canada to ISV/Reseller customers.

**Alternatives:**

* Use long codes or toll-free numbers for messaging traffic
* For OTP delivery, use [Plivo Verify](/docs/programmable-api/verify/overview) for short code-based OTP at no additional cost

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: Can I use the same sender ID for multiple brands?
chunks.text:
No. All messaging and calling compliance flows must be completed for each end brand separately.

If a sender ID is approved for Brand B1, it cannot be used for Brand B2, even for legitimate use cases like 2FA.

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: What content is prohibited for ISVs?
chunks.text:
The following categories are strictly prohibited. No campaign or toll-free verification will be supported:

| Category | Examples |
| - | - |
| Financial | Mortgage, loans, credit repair, debt collection |
| Investment | Stock alerts, cryptocurrency, high-risk investments |
| Marketing | Lead generation, affiliate marketing, MLM |
| Employment | Deceptive work-from-home, job postings |
| Real Estate | Sales, servicing |
| Gambling | Gambling, sweepstakes |
| Regulated | Tobacco/vape, illegal drugs, SHAFT content |

**SHAFT:** Sex, Hate, Alcohol, Firearms, and Tobacco

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.text:
| Type | Allowed |
| - | - |
| Public shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl.com) | No |
| ISV-owned shorteners | No |
| Brand-owned shorteners | Yes |

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: What are the opt-out requirements for ISVs?
chunks.text:
* If an end subscriber opts out, do not contact them again regardless of sender ID used
* Monitor incoming messages and remove opted-out customers from contact lists
* Subscribers on national do-not-call lists must be excluded
* Subscribe to available DNC lists

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.text:
Plivo blocks outbound messages containing specific keywords that may violate the AUP.

* ISVs can request to whitelist specific keywords on a case-by-case basis
* Decisions are at Plivo's compliance team discretion
* Two weeks notice given before enforcement of changes

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: Can ISVs redact message content or phone numbers?
chunks.text: No. ISVs cannot redact message content or destination phone numbers. This allows Plivo's compliance team to effectively monitor for non-compliance.

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: What happens if an ISV violates compliance rules?
chunks.text:
| Violation Type | Action |
| - | - |
| Single violation | SID or campaign suspension |
| Serious violation | All SIDs/campaigns under sub-account suspended without notice |
| Multiple violations | Account suspension |

chunks.title: A2P Guidelines for ISVs
chunks.section: How should ISVs report security compromises?
chunks.text:
If an ISV detects a compromise affecting message or call traffic:

1. Report immediately via email to [security-report@plivo.com](mailto:security-report@plivo.com)
2. Include relevant supporting details

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.text:
Common questions about sending and receiving SMS and MMS via Plivo API

Frequently asked questions about Plivo's Messaging API, throughput limits, message expiry, and data logging.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What does Plivo's Messaging API offer?
chunks.text:
Plivo's Messaging API enables SMS and MMS messaging to 200+ countries with:

* Programmable SMS/MMS via REST API
* High throughput delivery
* Delivery receipts and callbacks
* Message logging and analytics

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.text: MPS limits control how fast your account can send messages.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What is Messages Per Second (MPS)? › Default Limits
chunks.text:
| Type | Default MPS |
| - | - |
| SMS | 5 MPS |
| MMS | 0.25 MPS |

View your allocated MPS at **SMS > Overview** in the console.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What is the throughput for US numbers?
chunks.text:
| Number Type | SMS Throughput | MMS Throughput | Daily Limit |
| - | - | - | - |
| Long Code (Unregistered) | 1 msg/sec | 1 msg/sec | 2,000/day |
| Long Code (10DLC Low) | 0.2-0.75 msg/sec | Varies | Varies |
| Long Code (10DLC Standard) | 3.75-15 msg/sec | Varies | Varies |
| Toll-Free (Verified) | 25 msg/sec | 2 msg/sec | No limit |
| Short Code | 100+ msg/sec | Not supported | No limit |

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What is the throughput for Canada numbers?
chunks.text:
| Number Type | SMS | MMS |
| - | - | - |
| Long Code | 15/minute | 15/minute |
| Toll-Free | 25/second | 2/second |
| Short Code | 10/second | Not supported |

**Note:** Verify toll-free numbers to avoid sending limits.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What happens when a message expires?
chunks.text:
Messages remaining in queue after **3 hours** expire automatically.

* Message marked as "failed"
* Error code: 420
* No charge applied

Messages may expire due to carrier delays, invalid destination numbers, or network issues.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How can I control my data logging preferences?
chunks.text:
Control how Plivo stores your message data:

| Setting | Destination Number | Message Content |
| - | - | - |
| **Store Both** (Default) | Stored | Stored |
| **Store Number Only** | Stored | Not stored |
| **Store Content Only** | Not stored | Stored |
| **Store Neither** | Not stored | Not stored |

Set the `log` parameter in the [Send Message API](https://www.plivo.com/docs/messaging/api/message/#send-a-message).

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What's the difference between promotional and transactional SMS?
chunks.text:
| Type | Purpose | Examples |
| - | - | - |
| **Promotional** | Marketing, sales | Offers, discounts, advertisements |
| **Transactional** | Essential information | OTPs, order confirmations, alerts |

Different countries have varying regulations for each type.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How does Plivo protect against fraud? › Geo Permissions
chunks.text:
Restrict messaging to specific countries:

1. Navigate to **SMS > Settings > [Geo Permissions](https://cx.plivo.com/messaging-settings)**
2. Enable only required destination countries
3. Set messaging thresholds per country

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How does Plivo protect against fraud? › Unusual Traffic Alerts
chunks.text:
Plivo monitors for suspicious patterns:

* Sudden traffic spikes
* Unusual destinations
* Potential account takeover

You'll receive alerts via email when anomalies are detected.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How does Plivo protect against fraud? › Monthly Limits
chunks.text: Set spending caps to prevent runaway costs from fraud.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How do I export Message Detail Records (MDR)? › Via Console
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **SMS > Logs**
2. Click **Filter Logs** to refine
3. Select records to export
4. Click **Export**

Small exports download directly; large exports are emailed.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How do I export Message Detail Records (MDR)? › Via API
chunks.text: Use the [Message API](https://www.plivo.com/docs/messaging/api/message/#list-all-messages) to retrieve records programmatically.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How can I add a line break in my SMS or MMS message?
chunks.text:
Use `\n` for line breaks:

```bash theme={null}
curl -X POST "https://api.plivo.com/v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/" \
  -u "{auth_id}:{auth_token}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "src": "14151234567",
    "dst": "14157654321",
    "text": "Line 1\nLine 2\nLine 3"
  }'
```

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What countries do you support for SMS?
chunks.text:
| Direction | Coverage |
| - | - |
| Outbound SMS | 200+ countries |
| Inbound SMS | US, Canada, UK, Australia, France, Germany, Netherlands, Sweden, Austria, Belgium |

See [Plivo Coverage](https://www.plivo.com/sms/coverage/) for details.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What are the compliance standards for messaging?
chunks.text:
All messaging must follow:

* Regional laws and regulations
* Carrier policies
* [Plivo Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.plivo.com/aup/)

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: What are the compliance standards for messaging? › Prohibited Content
chunks.text:
* Unsolicited spam
* Fraudulent or deceptive content
* Violence, hate speech, obscenity
* Illegal substances promotion

See [Messaging Compliance](/docs/faq/messaging/messaging-compliance) for details.

chunks.title: Messaging API
chunks.section: How do I integrate with Bitrix24?
chunks.text:
1. Install Plivo from Bitrix24 Marketplace
2. Enter Auth ID, Auth Token, and sender ID
3. Click **Test SMS** to validate

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.text:
10DLC registration, A2P compliance, campaign approval, and rejection reasons

Frequently asked questions about sender IDs, country-specific regulations, DND/opt-out management, and delivery alerts.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.text: Sender ID is the name or number that appears as the message sender on the recipient's device.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What is a Sender ID? › Sender ID Types
chunks.text:
| Type | Example | Support |
| - | - | - |
| **Alphanumeric** | "MyBrand" | Country-dependent |
| **Numeric** | "+14151234567" | Most countries |
| **Short Code** | "12345" | US, Canada, UK |

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the Sender ID country categories?
chunks.text:
| Category | Description |
| - | - |
| **Dynamic** | Instant sender ID support |
| **Pre-registration** | Requires carrier approval before use |
| **Not Supported** | Must use numeric sender ID |

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: Which countries require Sender ID pre-registration?
chunks.text:
| Country | Registration Fee | Recurring Fee | ETA |
| - | - | - | - |
| Singapore | Yes | Monthly | Varies |
| UK | Yes | — | 1-2 weeks |

> [!NOTE]
>
> Plivo does not support domestic India SMS (DLT). Messages to India are delivered over international (ILDO) routes, which don't require Sender ID pre-registration. See [SMS availability](/docs/messaging/sms-availability).

Check [Plivo coverage](https://www.plivo.com/sms/coverage/) for country-specific requirements.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: How do I register a Sender ID?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Messaging > Settings > Sender ID**
2. Select country
3. Submit registration with required documents
4. Wait for carrier approval

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the requirements for sending SMS to India?
chunks.text:
Plivo does not support domestic India SMS, which requires DLT (distributed ledger technology) registration under TRAI regulations. SMS to India is delivered exclusively over international (ILDO) routes, which don't require DLT registration, templates, or PE-TM binding.

See [SMS availability](/docs/messaging/sms-availability) for current coverage and requirements.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the Singapore Sender ID requirements?
chunks.text:
**Full SMS Sender ID Registry (SSIR):**

* All sender IDs must be registered with SGNIC
* Unregistered sender IDs are blocked
* Registration required for all organizations

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the UK SMS regulations?
chunks.text:
**A2P SMS Filtering:**

* Carriers actively filter unregistered traffic
* Register sender IDs to avoid filtering
* Follow UK carrier guidelines

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: Can I send messages from Canadian long codes to US?
chunks.text:
**Cross-Border Restrictions:**

* Canadian long codes cannot send to US
* Use US numbers for US destinations
* Toll-free and short codes work cross-border

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What keywords trigger the "Do Not Disturb" (DND) feature?
chunks.text:
Plivo automatically recognizes these opt-out keywords (case-insensitive):

| Keyword | Action |
| - | - |
| STOP | Opt out |
| END | Opt out |
| QUIT | Opt out |
| CANCEL | Opt out |
| UNSUBSCRIBE | Opt out |
| UNSUB | Opt out |
| STOP ALL | Opt out |

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What happens when someone opts out?
chunks.text:
1. Recipient sends STOP keyword
2. Plivo adds number to suppression list
3. Future messages to that number are blocked
4. Messages fail with DND error code

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: Can my customers opt back in after opting out?
chunks.text:
Yes. Opt-in keywords:

| Keyword | Action |
| - | - |
| UNSTOP | Opt back in |
| START | Opt back in |

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: Can I reply to customers who have opted out?
chunks.text:
No. Messages to opted-out users:

* Are blocked by Plivo
* Fail with appropriate error code
* Are not charged

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: How can I ensure my messages adhere to DND regulations?
chunks.text:
* Include opt-out instructions in every message
* Example: "Reply STOP to opt out"
* Monitor inbound messages for complaints
* Only message explicit opt-ins

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: Can I receive email alerts for message delivery issues?
chunks.text: Yes. Plivo monitors delivery rates and alerts you to issues.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: Can I receive email alerts for message delivery issues? › Alert Types
chunks.text:
| Alert | Trigger |
| - | - |
| **Outbound** | Significant drop in delivery rate |
| **Inbound** | Issues delivering to your endpoint |

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: I've received an outbound delivery email alert from Plivo. What should I do?
chunks.text:
1. Review message content for spam triggers
2. Check number registration status
3. Verify destination numbers are valid

**Email includes:**

* Total messages sent in past hour
* Phone numbers with low delivery
* Suggested actions

**Frequency:** Maximum once per day per destination country

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: I've received an inbound delivery email alert from Plivo. What should I do?
chunks.text:
1. Check endpoint availability
2. Verify URL configuration
3. Review server logs for errors

**Evaluation:**

* Checks delivery rate every 15 minutes
* Looks at messages from past hour
* Alerts if delivery issues detected

**Frequency:** Maximum once per day

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: Why did my outbound SMS delivery fail?
chunks.text:
**Common causes:**

* Carrier filtering
* Invalid numbers
* Content violations

**Inbound issues:**

* Endpoint timeout
* Server errors (5xx)
* Invalid URL configuration

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What content is prohibited in messaging?
chunks.text:
* Unsolicited messages (spam)
* Fraudulent or deceptive content
* Violence, hate speech, obscenity
* Illegal drugs or substances
* Marketing to children under 13 (requires extra carrier review)

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What is age gating and when is it required?
chunks.text: Messages with age-restricted content (SHAFT: Sex, Hate, Alcohol, Firearms, Tobacco) must include age verification before opt-in.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the best practices for messaging compliance? › Consent
chunks.text:
* Obtain explicit opt-in before messaging
* Document consent method and timestamp
* Honor opt-outs immediately

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the best practices for messaging compliance? › Content
chunks.text:
* Avoid spam triggers
* Include sender identification
* Provide opt-out instructions

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the best practices for messaging compliance? › Record Keeping
chunks.text:
* Maintain opt-in records
* Log opt-out requests
* Document consent methods

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the penalties for messaging compliance violations?
chunks.text: Violations of messaging standards or [Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.plivo.com/aup/) result in penalties.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the penalties for messaging compliance violations? › Penalty Tiers
chunks.text:
| Tier | Violation Type | Fine |
| - | - | - |
| Tier 1 | Phishing, smishing, social engineering | \$2,000 USD |
| Tier 2 | Illegal content | \$1,000 USD |
| Tier 3 | Other violations (including SHAFT content) | \$500 USD |

Fines apply regardless of country. If a carrier imposes a fine, the amount is deducted from your account.

chunks.title: Messaging Compliance
chunks.section: What are the penalties for messaging compliance violations? › Consequences
chunks.text:
* Single violation: SID or campaign suspension
* Serious violation: All SIDs/campaigns suspended without notice
* Repeated violations: Account suspension

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.text:
MMS support, media types, file size limits, and delivery troubleshooting

Frequently asked questions about MMS messaging, supported media types, size limits, and delivery.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.text:
MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service) allows sending images, videos, and audio in addition to text.

**Availability:** US and Canada only

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: Is MMS supported by all carriers in the US and Canada? › Major Carriers
chunks.text:
* AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US)
* Rogers, Bell, Fido, Telus, Wind Canada

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: Is MMS supported by all carriers in the US and Canada? › Minor Carriers
chunks.text: 365 Wireless, Alaska Communication System (ACS), Alltel Wireless, Bluegrass Cellular, Boost Mobile, and others.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How much does it cost to send and receive MMS messages?
chunks.text:
| Direction | Cost per Message |
| - | - |
| Outbound | \$0.0160 |
| Inbound | \$0.0080 |

Volume discounts available—contact [Plivo Sales](https://www.plivo.com/contact/sales/).

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: Why was my SMS delivered as an MMS?
chunks.text: During peak traffic, Plivo's routing algorithm may occasionally send an SMS as an MMS to clear the queue faster and speed up delivery. To the recipient, the message looks like a regular long text SMS. You are billed only the standard SMS rate and the corresponding SMS carrier surcharge. Plivo covers the additional MMS costs and the associated carrier surcharge. For any concerns, please raise a support ticket with our team.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What types of multimedia content does Plivo accept?
chunks.text:
| Category | Formats |
| - | - |
| **Image** | JPEG, PNG, GIF |
| **Video** | MP4, 3GP, MOV |
| **Audio** | MP3, WAV, AMR |

See [full list](/docs/faq/messaging/mms) of accepted content types.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What are the size limitations for sending messages with text and images?
chunks.text:
| Limit | Value |
| - | - |
| Total message size | 5 MB |
| Maximum attachments | 10 files |
| Text content | 1,600 characters (\~4.8 KB) |
| Recommended image size | < 600 KB |

**Note:** Plivo does not resize images. Messages exceeding 5 MB fail with error code 120.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: Will Plivo automatically resize my images for MMS messaging?
chunks.text: No. Plivo does not resize images. You must ensure total message size is under 5 MB before sending.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What MMS content types does Plivo support?
chunks.text: Media URLs must return valid `Content-Type` and `Content-Length` headers. URLs without these headers are rejected.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How do I send MMS via API?
chunks.text:
```bash theme={null}
curl -X POST "https://api.plivo.com/v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/" \
  -u "{auth_id}:{auth_token}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "src": "14151234567",
    "dst": "14157654321",
    "type": "mms",
    "text": "Check out this image!",
    "media_urls": ["https://example.com/image.jpg"]
  }'
```

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How do I send MMS via Powerpack?

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How does Plivo manage delivery order of multiple media files via one MMS message?

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How can I upload media to an MMS message? › Via Console
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Messaging > MMS Media Upload**
2. Upload files
3. Use returned `media_id` in API requests

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How can I upload media to an MMS message? › Via API
chunks.text: Use the [Media API](https://www.plivo.com/docs/messaging/api/media/) to upload and manage files.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How can I upload media to an MMS message? › Hosted Media
chunks.text: Host media on any cloud storage (S3, GCS, etc.) and provide the URL in `media_urls`.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How long does Plivo store MMS media files?
chunks.text:
| Feature | Details |
| - | - |
| Storage duration | Up to 1 year |
| URL type | Publicly accessible |
| Extension | Case-by-case basis |

Media files sent or received are stored in your account with unique URLs.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How can I retrieve Plivo MMS media files?
chunks.text:
**Via SDK:** Use the list media method

**Via API:** Use the [Media API](https://www.plivo.com/docs/messaging/api/media/)

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How do I receive MMS messages?
chunks.text:
1. Set `message_url` on your Plivo application
2. Assign MMS-enabled number to application
3. Plivo POSTs inbound MMS to your URL

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: How do I receive MMS messages? › Inbound Parameters
chunks.text:
In addition to standard SMS parameters:

| Parameter | Description |
| - | - |
| `Type` | "mms" for multimedia messages |
| `Media0`, `Media1`, ... | URLs of attached media files |

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What do the different MMS delivery statuses mean?
chunks.text:
| Status | Meaning |
| - | - |
| **queued** | Message accepted, waiting to send |
| **sent** | Sent to carrier |
| **delivered** | Confirmed delivery to recipient |
| **undelivered** | Failed to deliver |
| **failed** | Error occurred |

View status in Message Detail Records or via delivery callbacks.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: Can I send and receive MMS on my toll-free phone number?
chunks.text:
Yes. Toll-free numbers support MMS in the US and Canada.

**Features:**

* Videos up to 40 seconds
* Audio files
* Animated GIFs
* Images and slideshows
* Automatic message queuing

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What are the MMS rate limits? › Account Level
chunks.text:
| Limit | Value |
| - | - |
| Default MMS MPS | 0.25 |
| API concurrency | 100 simultaneous requests |

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What are the MMS rate limits? › Per Number
chunks.text: Long code numbers have individual throughput limits.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What happens to MMS messages sent to unsupported destinations?
chunks.text: MMS to countries or devices without MMS support returns HTTP 400 error.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: What happens to MMS messages sent from unsupported phone numbers?
chunks.text: HTTP 400 error is returned. Use an MMS-enabled number.

chunks.title: MMS
chunks.section: Does Plivo do anything with the metadata associated with digital pictures?
chunks.text:
* Metadata (date, time, location) is usually stripped by sending carrier
* If carrier preserves metadata, Plivo passes it through
* No modification of received metadata

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.text:
Powerpack number pools, sticky sender, and intelligent number selection for SMS

Frequently asked questions about Powerpack, Plivo's intelligent number pool for optimized message delivery.

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.text:
Powerpack is a collection of phone numbers that work together to:

* Maximize message deliverability
* Manage opt-outs automatically
* Load balance across numbers
* Support multiple number types (long codes, toll-free, short codes)

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What are the benefits of Powerpack?
chunks.text:
| Feature | Description |
| - | - |
| **Intelligent routing** | Automatically selects best number for delivery |
| **Sticky sender** | Same number used for conversations with each recipient |
| **Opt-out management** | Automatic STOP keyword handling |
| **Number pool** | Combine long codes, toll-free, and short codes |
| **Compliance** | Respects carrier throughput limits |

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How do I create a Powerpack?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Messaging > Powerpack**
2. Click **Add New Powerpack**
3. Enter Powerpack name
4. Add phone numbers to the pool
5. Configure application settings
6. Save

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What types of numbers can I add to Powerpack? › Long Codes
chunks.text:
Add US/Canada long codes for A2P messaging:

* Requires 10DLC registration for optimal throughput
* Recommended: < 200 messages/day per number

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What types of numbers can I add to Powerpack? › Toll-Free Numbers
chunks.text:
Add verified toll-free numbers:

* Higher throughput (25 MPS)
* Best for 2FA, notifications

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What types of numbers can I add to Powerpack? › Short Codes
chunks.text:
Add short codes for maximum throughput:

* One US short code per Powerpack
* One Canada short code per Powerpack
* Same short code cannot be in multiple Powerpacks

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: Can I add a short code number to my Powerpack?
chunks.text: Yes. You can add one US short code and one Canada short code per Powerpack.

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: Can I add multiple short code numbers to my Powerpack?
chunks.text: No. Only one US short code and one Canada short code per Powerpack.

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: Can I add the same short code number to multiple Powerpacks?
chunks.text: No. A short code can only belong to one Powerpack.

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What are the benefits of adding a short code to my Powerpack?
chunks.text:
* Maximum throughput (100+ MPS)
* Carrier-approved for A2P messaging
* Falls back to long codes if short code is unavailable

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: Why are long code numbers being used for outbound messages when I have a short code in my Powerpack?
chunks.text:
Even with short code priority enabled, long codes may be used when:

* Short code throughput exceeded
* Network compatibility issues
* Carrier-specific routing

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How do I remove a short code from my Powerpack?
chunks.text:
To disable short code:

1. Disable "prioritize short code" feature
2. Messages will use other numbers

To permanently remove:

1. Open support ticket
2. Request short code removal

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How can I send SMS and MMS messages using Powerpack? › SMS via API

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How can I send SMS and MMS messages using Powerpack? › MMS via Powerpack

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.text:
Smart Sender ensures that a destination number always receives texts from the same source number. This stickiness enables two-way conversations by keeping the conversation thread intact.

Once a Powerpack number is assigned to a destination, all subsequent texts to that destination are sent from the assigned source number.

Turn on Smart Sender from the Plivo console's Powerpack dashboard.

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.text:
Local Connect is a Powerpack feature that personalizes conversations by using the same area codes and local numbers as your users.

It uses area code matching and prioritizes local numbers over other numbers in the Powerpack pool.

Manage Local Connect preferences from the Powerpack management console.

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What happens when a Powerpack SMS or MMS recipient replies with an opt-out keyword?
chunks.text:
When recipient texts STOP:

1. Subscriber added to suppression list for that source number
2. Future messages to that recipient are blocked
3. Message marked "failed" with appropriate error code

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What happens when a Powerpack SMS or MMS recipient replies with an opt-out keyword? › Suppression List
chunks.text:
* Per-number suppression tracking
* Automatic compliance with opt-out requests
* View suppression list in console

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How are incoming messages to numbers in my Powerpack handled?
chunks.text: Assign an application to your Powerpack to handle incoming messages.

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How can I modify an application associated with a Powerpack?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to your Powerpack
2. In Application Configuration, select type:
   * **XML Application**
   * **PHLO**
3. Select the application name
4. Update

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How can I remove an application from Powerpack?
chunks.text:
1. Open Powerpack settings
2. In application type, select any option
3. In application name dropdown, select "-------"
4. Update

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: Can I use PHLOs to handle incoming messages in my Powerpack?
chunks.text:
Yes. Use PHLO for visual message handling:

1. Create a PHLO for incoming messages
2. Add PHLO to Powerpack's application configuration
3. Incoming messages trigger PHLO workflow

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How can I send 6,000 or more SMS messages per day using a long code in the US?
chunks.text:
For US long codes without 10DLC, the limit is < 200 messages/day per number.

**Options:**

* Register for 10DLC to increase limits
* Add multiple numbers to your Powerpack
* Use toll-free or short codes

| Volume | Recommended |
| - | - |
| < 2,000/day | Registered long codes |
| 2,000-50,000/day | Toll-free |
| 50,000+/day | Short code |

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How can I configure my Powerpack source number pool? › Add Numbers
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to Powerpack
2. Click **Add Numbers**
3. Select from available numbers
4. Add to pool

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: How can I configure my Powerpack source number pool? › Remove Numbers
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to Powerpack
2. Select numbers to remove
3. Click **Remove**

chunks.title: Powerpack
chunks.section: What happens if I unrent a Powerpack phone number?
chunks.text: The number is removed from the Powerpack. Messages will be sent from remaining numbers in the pool.

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.text:
Short code provisioning, approval process, and messaging limits

Frequently asked questions about short code messaging, application process, and country-specific requirements.

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.text:
A short code is a 4-6 digit number designed for high-volume messaging. Short codes offer:

* Highest throughput (up to 100 MPS in US)
* Carrier-approved for A2P and promotional messaging
* Bypass carrier content filtering
* Easy to remember for customers

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.text:
| Country | Digits | Types | SMS | MMS |
| - | - | - | - | - |
| United States | 5-6 | Random, Vanity | Yes | Yes |
| Canada | 5-6 | Random | Yes | No |
| Brazil | 5 | Random | Yes | No |
| New Zealand | 4 | FTEU, Standard | Yes | No |

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What is the throughput for short codes?
chunks.text:
| Country | SMS Throughput |
| - | - |
| United States | 100 MPS |
| Canada | 10 MPS |
| Brazil | Varies |
| New Zealand | Varies |

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: How much do short codes cost?
chunks.text:
| Country | Setup Fee | Monthly Rental | Procurement Time |
| - | - | - | - |
| United States (Random) | \$1,500 | \$500 | 6-8 weeks |
| United States (Vanity) | \$1,500 | \$1,000 | 6-8 weeks |
| Canada | \$4,000 | \$700 | 6-8 weeks |
| Brazil | \$0 | \$500 | 4 weeks |
| New Zealand | \$156 | \$156 | 3-4 weeks |

Rental charges are deducted in advance on a quarterly basis.

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What is the difference between random and vanity short codes?
chunks.text:
| Type | Description | Cost |
| - | - | - |
| Random | Assigned by CSCA | Lower monthly rental |
| Vanity | Custom number (e.g., 75486 = PLIVO) | Higher monthly rental |

Vanity short codes are subject to availability and only available in the US.

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the requirements for US short codes?
chunks.text:
1. Update Terms and Conditions page with carrier-required language
2. Ensure web opt-in forms contain mandated verbiage
3. Configure keyword responses (opt-in, opt-out, HELP)
4. Submit application with usage details

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the requirements for US short codes? › Required Keywords
chunks.text:
| Keyword | Purpose | Required Response |
| - | - | - |
| STOP | Opt-out | Confirmation of opt-out |
| HELP | Help | Program description and contact info |
| YES/JOIN | Opt-in | Confirmation of subscription |

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the requirements for Canada short codes?
chunks.text:
* Carriers must review use case and campaign details
* Shared short codes not supported
* Specific language requirements for Terms and Conditions
* Same application steps as US

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the requirements for Brazil short codes?
chunks.text:
* 5 digits, random only
* Messages are Free To End User (FTEU)
* Express consent required before sending
* 35 days notice required to give up a short code
* Unused short codes may be disconnected by regulators

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the requirements for Brazil short codes? › Content Restrictions (Brazil)
chunks.text:
| Allowed | Prohibited |
| - | - |
| Alerts, Marketing, Notifications | Adult content |
| OTP, Promotions, Special offers | Gambling/casinos |
| Political, Religious | Illegal products, Malware, Spam |

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the requirements for New Zealand short codes? › Types
chunks.text:
| Type | Description |
| - | - |
| Free To End User (FTEU) | All charges to short code owner |
| Standard | Recipient may be charged |

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the requirements for New Zealand short codes? › Messaging Requirements
chunks.text:
For **Standard** short codes:

* If expecting a reply: include "standard charges apply"
* If message contains URL: include "data charges apply"
* If no response needed: add "No Text Reply"

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What triggers a short code audit?
chunks.text:
Carriers in US and Canada conduct audits for:

* Deviation from registered use cases
* Non-compliant traffic (prohibited content, missing opt-in)
* Using same short code for multiple brands (shared short code)

Potential outcomes include short code suspension, use case disallowed, or fines.

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What qualifies as a shared short code?
chunks.text: When a short code registered for one purpose (e.g., account notifications) is used to send messages for another brand. This is prohibited by carriers.

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.section: What are the US Short Code Registry updates?
chunks.text:
Effective October 2024, the registry requires:

| Entity | Required Information |
| - | - |
| CSC Registrants | Legal name, entity type, physical address, URL, FEIN |
| Content Providers | Point of contact (name, email, phone) |
| Brand Clients | Organization details and verification |

Brand clients receive a verification email from Aegis Mobile with a link and PIN for completion.

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.text:
* Short codes auto-renew by default
* To discontinue: contact Plivo support
* Decommissioned short codes cannot be reactivated
* Failure to notify results in continued rental charges

chunks.title: Short Codes
chunks.text:
No. Plivo does not offer short codes for A2P messaging in US or Canada to ISV/Reseller customers.

**Alternatives:**

* Long codes or toll-free numbers for messaging
* [Plivo Verify](/docs/programmable-api/verify/overview) for short code-based OTP delivery

chunks.text:

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.text:
SMS delivery, encoding, concatenation, sender ID, and country-specific rules

Frequently asked questions about SMS messaging, character limits, concatenation, and delivery.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What is the character limit for SMS text messages? › GSM-7 Encoding (Standard Characters)
chunks.text:
| Message Length | Segments | Characters per Segment |
| - | - | - |
| 1-160 characters | 1 | 160 |
| 161-1600 characters | Multiple | 153 (7 chars for header) |

**Maximum:** 1,600 characters (splits into \~11 segments)

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What is the character limit for SMS text messages? › Unicode Encoding (Special Characters)
chunks.text:
| Message Length | Segments | Characters per Segment |
| - | - | - |
| 1-70 characters | 1 | 70 |
| 71+ characters | Multiple | 67 (3 chars for header) |

When any Unicode character appears in your message, the entire message uses UCS-2 encoding.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.text: Automatic encoding replaces Unicode characters with GSM-7 equivalents to prevent accidental segmentation from smart quotes, em dashes, etc.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What is automatic encoding? › Enable Auto-Replace
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Messaging > Settings > Other Settings**
2. Enable **Auto-replace**

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.text:
Long messages are automatically split and reassembled:

1. Plivo splits message into segments
2. Concatenation header added to each segment
3. Carrier reassembles at delivery
4. Recipient sees single message

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: How does SMS concatenation work? › Billing
chunks.text: Each segment is billed separately. A 200-character message = 2 segments = 2x SMS cost.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: How do I send SMS via API? › Single Message

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: How do I send SMS via API? › Can I send bulk SMS?
chunks.text:
Yes. Send to multiple recipients in one request:

```bash theme={null}
curl -X POST "https://api.plivo.com/v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/" \
  -u "{auth_id}:{auth_token}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "src": "14151234567",
    "dst": "14157654321<14158765432<14159876543",
    "text": "Bulk message to multiple recipients"
  }'
```

Separate destinations with `<` character.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: How can I receive SMS messages on my Plivo numbers?
chunks.text:
1. Create an application with a `message_url`
2. Assign a Plivo number to the application
3. Plivo POSTs inbound messages to your URL

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: How is an incoming message delivered to my application?
chunks.text:
| Stage | Description |
| - | - |
| **Received** | Plivo receives from carrier (charged) |
| **Delivered** | Successfully posted to your `message_url` |
| **Undelivered** | Failed to deliver to your URL |

If `message_url` is not configured, messages remain in "received" status.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: Can the source number for an outbound text message be a non-Plivo number? › US and Canada
chunks.text:
* **Must use Plivo number** as source
* Non-Plivo numbers not permitted (telecom regulations)

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: Can the source number for an outbound text message be a non-Plivo number? › International
chunks.text:
* Dynamic sender IDs may be used
* Delivery not guaranteed for non-Plivo numbers
* Check [country coverage](https://www.plivo.com/sms/coverage/) for sender ID support

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What are Geo-Permissions and why should I use them?
chunks.text: Geo-Permissions control which countries can receive your SMS, protecting against fraud.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What are Geo-Permissions and why should I use them? › Default Enabled Countries
chunks.text:
* United States
* United Kingdom
* India

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What are Geo-Permissions and why should I use them? › How Can I Manage Geo-Permissions?
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Messaging > Settings > [Geo Permissions](https://cx.plivo.com/messaging-settings)**
2. Enable/disable countries as needed
3. Set messages-per-hour fraud thresholds

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: Can I configure SMS Geo Permissions for each subaccount separately?
chunks.text:
Yes. By default, subaccounts inherit main account settings.

**Override for subaccount:**

1. Go to Geo Permissions
2. Select subaccount from dropdown
3. Customize settings
4. Subaccount shows "Overridden" tag

**Remove override:**

1. Select overridden subaccount
2. Click **Remove Override**

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: Why are my outbound messages failing with error code 450?
chunks.text:
Error 450 means "destination country barred." The destination country is not enabled in your Geo Permissions.

Enable the country in **Messaging > Settings > Geo Permissions**.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What is SMS Pumping and how does Plivo protect against it?
chunks.text: SMS pumping is fraud where attackers flood OTP fields with fake requests to premium numbers.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What is SMS Pumping and how does Plivo protect against it? › Protection Features
chunks.text:
Enabled by default for all accounts:

* Automated traffic analysis
* Suspicious pattern detection
* Alerts for unusual activity

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What is SMS Pumping and how does Plivo protect against it? › How to Prevent SMS Pumping Attacks?
chunks.text:
* Enable [Geo Permissions](#what-are-geo-permissions-and-why-should-i-use-them)
* Set rate limits on OTP endpoints
* Implement CAPTCHA on forms
* Monitor traffic patterns
* Use Plivo's fraud detection tools

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: How to access the message content?
chunks.text: Message content is stored for **7 days**.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: How to access the message content? › View in Console
chunks.text:
1. Navigate to **Messaging > Logs**
2. Search by timeframe or UUID
3. View message details

**Note:** Only available if data logging is enabled.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: Why should I authorize Plivo to view my SMS content?
chunks.text:
Allow Plivo support to view content for debugging:

* Helps identify spam filter triggers
* Assists with delivery issues
* Enables content policy review

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What happens to my outbound messages if I don't have sufficient balance?
chunks.text:
When balance is insufficient:

1. Messages fail with error code 900
2. API requests fail for 2 minutes with "Insufficient Credit"
3. Queued messages continue to fail until recharged

Set up [auto-recharge](/docs/faq/billing-and-invoices/payments) to prevent interruptions.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: Why were we charged for an undelivered SMS message?
chunks.text:
Plivo charges when a message is successfully handed off to downstream carriers. Once accepted by the carrier, Plivo has no control over final delivery.

Reasons for undelivered status:

* Invalid or unreachable destination number
* Carrier filtering
* Device issues (phone off, full inbox)

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What are the different SMS statuses in Plivo?
chunks.text:
| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| **queued** | Message accepted, waiting to send |
| **sent** | Successfully passed to downstream carrier (charged) |
| **delivered** | Confirmed delivery to recipient device |
| **undelivered** | Carrier could not deliver to recipient |
| **failed** | Internal error before reaching carrier (not charged) |

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.text:
US carriers impose surcharges on toll-free messaging:

| Carrier | Surcharge per Segment |
| - | - |
| Verizon | \$0.0025 |
| T-Mobile | Varies |
| AT&T | Varies |

Surcharges appear as separate invoice line items.

chunks.title: SMS
chunks.section: What is the Number Lookup API?
chunks.text:
Get information about phone numbers:

* Local and E.164 formatting
* Carrier information
* Caller ID name (CNAM)

See [Lookup API documentation](https://www.plivo.com/docs/lookup/).

chunks.title: US Messaging (10DLC, Toll-Free, Short Codes)
chunks.section: What is required for A2P messaging in the US?
chunks.text:
US carriers require registration or verification for A2P (Application-to-Person) messaging:

| Number Type | Registration | Throughput | Best For |
| - | - | - | - |
| **10DLC** | Brand + Campaign | 3.75-15+ MPS | General A2P |
| **Toll-Free** | Verification | 25 MPS | High volume, 2FA |
| **Short Code** | Application | 100+ MPS | Marketing, alerts |

chunks.title: US Messaging (10DLC, Toll-Free, Short Codes)
chunks.text: 10DLC (10-Digit Long Code) is the standard for A2P messaging on local US numbers.
